item.title: Corus revenue slumps in first quarter as Blue Jays help drive TV ad dollars to Rogers
item.description: TORONTO — The Toronto Blue Jays' World Series run last fall spurred massive audiences for Rogers' broadcasts, but rival Corus Entertainment Inc. says that meant it saw fewer ad dollars.

item.title: First Nation leaders call for long-term solutions amid Kashechewan water crisis
item.description: First Nation leaders in northern Ontario are urging the federal and provincial governments to expedite evacuations and commit to long-term solutions as one community continues to deal with failures in its water supply and sewage systems.

item.title: Female family doctors in Ontario spend more time with patients, make less money: study
item.description: TORONTO — A new study says female family doctors in Ontario spend more time with patients than their male colleagues and in many cases earn less money as a result.
